headline: Is First Solar (FSLR) Still Reasonable After Its 45 GW Backlog?
summary: First Solar stock has delivered a 154.4% gain over the past 5 years. Current checks suggest the market price may still sit below an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow, which currently points to the shares trading at a discount. Over 5 years, First Solar has returned 154.4%, which puts long term holders ahead of many broad equity benchmarks and makes the current price more sensitive to what the company can earn from here.
